title: GALILEO: Geometric RoPE with Galilean Key Transport for Dynamic Scenes
abstract: arXiv:2611.29293v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Geometry-aware rotary positional encodings, such as RayRoPE, help attention reason about the 3D spatial relationships between tokens and the query camera. However, they implicitly assume a static scene, encoding each key at its observed position regardless of when it was captured. For dynamic scenes with temporally separated input views, this mismatch places the same moving object at a different position in each input frame, so it can be rendered at an inaccurate position. While temporal encodings inform attention when a token was observed, they do not resolve where its content should be at the query time. We introduce a simple and general approach that aligns positional encodings with dynamic scene geometry through Galilean transport. Before positional encoding, each key's 3D position is transported to the query time using its estimated velocity and the temporal offset. translated_title: GALILEO：面向动态场景、基于伽利略关键点传输的几何旋转位置编码
translated_abstract: 几何感知旋转位置编码（如RayRoPE）能够帮助注意力机制理解token与查询相机之间的3D空间关系。然而，这类方法隐式假设场景是静态的，无论key是在何时被捕获的，都只在其被观测到的位置进行编码。对于具有时间上相互分离的输入视图的动态场景而言，这种不匹配会导致同一运动物体在每个输入帧中处于不同的位置，从而可能在不准确的位置被渲染出来。虽然时间编码能告知注意力机制某个token是何时被观测的，但它们无法解决该内容在查询时刻应该处于什么位置的问题。我们提出了一种简单而通用的方法，通过伽利略传输使位置编码与动态场景几何对齐。在进行位置编码之前，利用每个key的估计速度和时间偏移，将其3D位置传输到查询时刻。由于该方法仅修改key的位置，因此可以直接集成到现有的……
tldr: 提出GALILEO方法，通过利用估计速度和时间偏移将每个key的3D位置以伽利略传输方式搬运到查询时刻，使几何感知旋转位置编码适配动态场景，从而在多时相输入视角下对运动物体进行准确定位与渲染。
en_tdlr: GALILEO adapts geometry-aware rotary positional encodings to dynamic scenes by transporting each key's 3D position to the query time through Galilean transport using estimated velocities and temporal offsets, enabling accurate positioning of moving objects across temporally separated input views.
